title: 5 graphs that show how heatwaves are getting more dangerous
description: Longer-lasting hot spells and high temperatures at night are making it harder to cope, leading to thousands more deaths from extreme heat
author: Jacklin KwanandAlec Luhn

title: Ovaries may turn into an 'immune-like organ' after the menopause
description: The ovaries of aged mice become infiltrated with immune cells linked to widespread inflammation in the body, and the same change could be happening in women
author: Starre Vartan

title: Bumblebee facial movements give clues to their inner lives
description: A series of experiments shows that bees respond differently to tastes depending on their internal states, hinting that they have something akin to our emotions
author: James Woodford

title: Artefacts hint at cultural exchange between Neanderthals and humans
description: A cave on the Turkish Mediterranean coast was inhabited first by Neanderthals and then Homo sapiens, but the continuity of tools and personal objects suggests there was some sharing of culture between the two species
author: James Woodford

title: 5 things to know about sunscreen, according to a skin cancer expert
description: How much sunscreen should you be using, when should you apply it, and are there any downsides to doing so? Skin cancer expert Rachel Neale is here to answer all of these questions and more
author: Rachel Neale

title: Collapse of AMOC ocean current may already be locked in
description: The fate of the Atlantic Ocean current that keeps Europe’s climate warm depends on our carbon emissions and the rate of ice melt from Greenland, but there is a chance that a shutdown is already inevitable
author: Chris Simms
